plan: A tank mummy who flings himself at his target with his bandage and stuns a whole team with his ultimate.
aSurveiller: His Q (Bandage Toss). He grabs the first enemy hit, pulls himself to them and stuns them: stay behind your minions so they block the bandage.
contrer: Spread out in team fights: his R stuns everyone around him.
Stay behind your minions: his bandage (Q) stops on the first enemy hit.
Favour magic damage: his E mostly reduces physical damage.
forces: His R can stun a whole team.
Two bandages to engage or catch up.
Very tanky and simple to play.
faiblesses: Predictable: everything depends on his bandage.
Weak if he can't reach melee range.

sorts.P: His attacks curse: the target takes true damage on top of magic damage.
sorts.Q: Bandage that pulls him to the enemy hit and stuns.
sorts.W: Aura that constantly damages nearby enemies.
sorts.E: Reduces physical damage taken and hurts around him.
sorts.R: Stuns and damages all enemies around him.

momentFort: Almost non-existent early: he farms until level 6. Invade him early, before his R changes the fights.
